topic: This video discusses James Harden's record for the most missed three-point shots in NBA history.

hook.first_frame: James Harden dribbling a basketball on a court.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: JAMES HARDEN HAS MISSED MORE THREES THAN ANYONE IN NBA HISTORY.

shots.shows: James Harden shooting a three-pointer with a stat graphic overlay
Steph Curry with a stat graphic overlay
James Harden walking on the court
James Harden looking at the camera
James Harden walking on the court

ending.last_frame: James Harden walking on the court with a stat graphic overlay.

script: James Harden has missed more threes than anyone in NBA history. 5,933. And he's made more threes than anyone except Steph Curry. Second in misses is Curry: 5,825. In one season, Harden took 1,028 threes. The most ever. So is he a bad shooter? No. Harden makes 36% from three. LeBron makes 35%. Harden just shot more threes than anyone not named Curry: 9,323.
what_makes_it_work: Uses surprising statistics to hook the viewer immediately.
Fast-paced editing keeps the viewer engaged throughout the short duration.
Clear, concise narration provides context for the statistics presented.
